description.subtitle: T-shirt of the second equipment Kelme del Espanyol 2025 2025 - beige
description.tagline: Make it to the fullest, wherever you go
description.intro: The Kelme 2nd Espanyol 25 26 T-Shirt combines comfort, breathability and a DNA-inspired design from the RCD Espanyol. The second Kelme equipment T-shirt from the Espanyol 2025 2025 - beige. Its sand-tone finish and official details raise your presence in and out of the field. Ideal for those looking for performance without giving up style.
key_benefits: Comfort that accompanies: Lightweight and soft fabric that prevents frictions to concentrate on the game.
Fresh during the match: breathable panels that help manage sweat at peak moments.
Orgullo que se nota: Detalles y escudo oficiales para lucir tus colores con autenticidad.
Versatilidad total: Perfecta para partidos, entrenamientos o combinar con tu outfit diario.
